5 things to try with @Muse this weekend beyond the usual email, calendar, and subscription workflows:

1. Set up a personalized feed

Muse's Feed is refreshing because it doesn't have AI slop or ads.

You can personalize it around the exact topics you care about, plus reminders tied to your life. I love scrolling through it every morning.

2. Fill out forms and comparison shop online

Ask Muse to help renew your driver's license, compare car insurance options, or book hard-to-get restaurant and show reservations.

It's very capable, especially combined with item 5 below.

3. Monitor your DMs

Muse has first-party connections to Instagram, Threads, and Messenger. If you install the desktop app, it can see your iMessages too.

Have it monitor your messages for anything you need to follow up on instead of you having to check 4 different message inboxes yourself.

4. Buy and sell on Facebook Marketplace

Other agents can do this too, but Muse makes it easy through its first-party integration.

Snap a photo, upload it to Muse, and ask it to list the item. You can also have it regularly search for the best deals on something you want and DM sellers directly.

5. Find and talk to human customer support

This is the killer feature IMO. Muse can navigate phone trees, wait on hold, and talk to a human customer support rep while representing itself as your agent.

It also says it can dial you in halfway through the call, although I haven't been able to get that working yet.

By the way, if you don't have access to this, ask Muse to message Meta and request access. I got it a day after doing this.

Last but not least, I think Muse's Ideas tab (below) is very well done.

The biggest problem with chat interfaces is that most people have no idea what to ask. Ideas solves that by suggesting useful, personalized things Muse can do for you.

My only complaint so far:

Muse's compaction doesn't seem to work as well as ChatGPT. If I discuss several topics in the main thread, it sometimes gets confused.

Beyond that, it's been delightful to use. I can tell the team spent months polishing this.

📌 Watch my full Muse walkthrough here: https://t.co/jte6evu5iI

tweets.text:
I spend ~2 hours a day programming, building side projects, tinkering obsessively, trying new repos..

I get basically a DM a day asking “aren’t you a VC, why are you doing this?”

Unlike other eras, things are moving SO fast that if you don’t do this, I simply don’t understand how folks will ever learn what’s coming next. 

For me, it’s quite simple if you want to invest in the AI era:

1) You have to understand the model capabilities to see where the next set of models will improve - still so much alpha in reading technical papers (model research)

2) You need to see what tools do they need to be successful and complete even longer long horizon tasks (infra) 

3) You need to understand the harness capabilities that will make these models help building autonomous companies (app layer)

You can obviously learn this by talking to researchers / builders and simply betting on founders - and I do that too. But, I was never honestly good at learning without getting my hands dirty so just leaning in to what I know best. It’s also honestly so fun!

So, my push to other folks who want to learn is just get started and find time to tinker daily. Once you do it for 10 days, I’m sure you’ll be equally obsessed!

tweets.text:
Personal agents are the ultimate manifestation of “build something that agents want”.

The form factor of a product like Muse is you want to be able to hand off a task to the agent and ensure that it is fully completed end to end. To do this, the agent must be able to successfully operate with your tools or use its own to complete the task. Use your MCP or CLI, easily navigate your site, be able to transact, and more.

The new attention you need to compete for is not from the user itself but instead for the agent. This means that the tools that allow agents to order food, handle ecommerce transactions, book flights, work with the local economy, and interact with our data and information best, are the ones that will get used the most.

This will ultimately be the biggest opportunity and shakeup in consumer tech since the App Store itself.

这波还有些基本面的老登币似乎都迎来了爆拉，现在轮到了 arweave:native 。

突然涨了50%后，小编没有看到任何合理的单币专属催化剂，只能认为是从 L1到存储板块的资金轮动了。

从各大投资社群的情绪来看，大家普遍又认为山寨季快来了，可以预测后续还会有更多之前无人问津、但仍在运行且有点基本面的老币，还会被雨露均沾到。

加密市场的常态是牛短熊长，上涨是一瞬间的牛来，下跌则是一场漫长的潮湿。

下周的重点，应该还是继续深挖那些还有基本面的老币，把握这轮“越老越妖”的小高潮。

上个周期被大家冠以“天王级”的项目，如果还没发币，这个周期大概发不出来币了。

Linera 就是最新的样本。

之前由 a16z 等机构累计投资约 1200 万美元，创始人来自 Meta、参与过 Libra 稳定币项目，并试图用微链做出更低延迟、更接近 Web2 实时体验的 L1。

就是这样的 Linera，昨天宣布立即停运，因为计划代币$LNRA 社区轮公售 150 万美元，但实际只凑到不到 90 万，选择全额退款，后续紧急融资也失败。

这个资源和背景放在上个周期，那妥妥是大家预期无限拔高，交互内卷的项目。

但现在，一级市场和社区公售都更挑剔，大家更愿意给已经有真实使用和收入的项目付钱，而不是选择再给一条“还在路上”的 L1 付钱。

另一面是，老登公链已经被去魅。

链不再稀缺，TPS、最终性、新架构都讲过了，市场并不需要再多一条“技术更好”的新链。

但有意思的是，最近一些上个版本老登币还在涨。
留下来还有壳子的，代币或许会有炒作；没有代币、还没上主网的，真的连这个期权都没有了。

这轮周期很明显，技术已经不够被单独定价了。市场可以炒一个十年前的隐私币，也可以给已经有手续费的应用代币溢价，但大概率不会再给一条还没证明过非用它不可的新链预付未来。

大人，时代变了。

- meta’s ai models are built from the ground up to power a personal agent that actually works across your entire life. this is different from a generalized LLM like claude or gpt.

- agent social network: the agent learns across every user interaction in your friend network. this is basically facebook 2.0 for agents! 

- metas data moat is a huge advantage. they know what you want and how to get it for you. 

- convenience: each user gets their own virtual computer which means your agent can operate a browser, apps and desktop independently - no hardware or openclae setup needed. 

- privacy: zuck knows that people won’t just hand over data. encryption is core

zuck essentially launched a new app store for agents today and Meta’s perfectly placed to crush it, you’re looking at a multi-trillion dollar opp if they pull it off:

- instead of apps, agents get equipped with connectors i.e. plugins to any app, service or software tool.

- suddenly your agent goes from a useless chatbot to an action-oriented helper that gets shit done for you

but it gets even better - meta has collected ALL the data about you. they know what you want, when you want it which means they know exactly WHICH connectors to list in a marketplace and HOW MUCH to charge because they know customers will pay.

it’s a masterclass. muse isn’t just some generic agent, it’s sitting on a treasure trove of data and meta can build a trillion dollar business on top of it.

Here we go again! The WSJ is working on a story blaming Coinbase and me personally for the CLARITY Act not passing.

The Journal has repeatedly been hostile to CLARITY in its reporting, regurgitating bank lobby talking points, while I’ve spent years pushing for crypto legislation, but that’s not stopping them from trying to reverse the blame.

The boring TLDR: in January I opposed a draft of the bill going into a committee vote, because it needed a lot of work on DeFi, tokenization, CFTC authority, and stablecoin rewards. At the time, the bill had major issues that would have harmed crypto. Support was fractured, and it wasn’t passable. We worked with a number of parties who improved the bill and made it passable. All four of the items I called out were fixed in the draft that then went through the committee about four months later. I'm proud to have done it, and would do it again, because it helped create a better bill. One step of many along the way.

The final draft of CLARITY that went to the Senate was great, and I strongly supported it. I'll continue showing up for our customers and pushing for clear rules that treat crypto fairly, even if those who feel threatened by crypto try to plant false stories. It's a shame that the WSJ takes direction from bank lobbyists instead of reporting the truth, but luckily, people are smart enough to see through it these days, and it backfires on them every time.

小编偷偷发一次律动Pro的文章总结给你们看，这是要花钱的，读完你们看看值不值。

主编真的不让发，你们不要告诉他！

《SEC豁免新政催生山寨牛，UNI外哪些项目最值得关注》

💎核心背景与行业转变

政策红利：SEC 豁免政策为链上股票交易打开了合规大门。
叙事升级：UNI 从“加密 DEX”升级为“链上股票交易中心”。
市场重点转向：从单纯的“发行股票代币”，转向“谁能赋予代币化股票更多金融用途（收益拆分、借贷、结构化产品等）”。

四大潜在获利板块与代表项目

1️⃣股息与收益分离（Yield Stripping）
将股票代币拆分为本金代币（PT）和收益代币（YT），实现收益的二次交易。
Pendle（$PENDLE）：加密原生收益交易龙头，已在 Robinhood Chain 上试水英伟达（NVDA）股息分离产品，为该领域最确定性的基础设施候选。
Pare Stocks（$PARE）：Robinhood 链原生协议，已支持 AAPL、SPY、QQQ 等标的拆分（拆分费 10 bps，收益赎回费 5%），YT 收益源于发行人披露的股息参数。

2️⃣信贷与结构化收益（Lending & Structured Products）
赋予股票代币抵押借贷与票据化属性，提高资金利用率。
Morpho（$MORPHO）：隔离市场借贷协议，可针对单只股票代币精细化配置风险参数（抵押率、清算线），极为适合建立独立股票借贷池。
Gage（$GAGE）：Robinhood 链点对点固定成本借贷，支持以代币化股票或 Meme 作抵押借出 USDG。主打“到期不还清算资产而非强制平仓”模式。
Note Systems（$NOTE）：Robinhood 链结构化票据协议，将股票代币包装成“带障碍价格、自动赎回”的票息产品（如年化票息与下跌保护结构）。

3️⃣多链流量出口 DEX（EVM & Non-EVM）
股票代币交易热潮将向 Ethereum/Robinhood 链之外的生态辐射：
PancakeSwap（$CAKE）：BSC 生态的绝对 DEX 龙头，承接 BSC 链上的股票代币交易流量。
Raydium（$RAY）：Solana 生态核心 AMM，高弹性标的，若 Solana 出现股票代币与配对 Meme 发行潮，将最直接受益。

4️⃣币股 Meme 的爆发行情与两条新路径
传统币股 Meme（如结合股票概念的代币）在政策后呈现两条新分化路径：
获得底层公司/创始人积极回应（正向背书）：
SEC 政策赋予了上市公司“交易阻断权”。因此，公司态度至关重要。
正例（BONER）：其正股 Hims & Hers（HIMS）创始人关注了 BONER 官方账号，社区解读为积极信号，支撑其高市值。
反例（MEME）：因 AMC CEO 对 Robinhood 股票代币公开排斥，缺乏长期监管与正统性预期。
链上股权控制权与无主基金会（治理演进）：
https://t.co/tIaRLYPy43（$GSTOCK 等）：BSC 上的新尝试，主张将股票代币放入无主基金会，通过链上多签在链下行使真实股权权利（结合 CZ 提及的 BNC 生态与财库公司概念）。

📒总结与风险提示

短期看点：围绕 收益拆分（Pendle）、抵押借贷（Morpho/Gage）、结构化票据（Note） 和 流量 DEX（Pancake/Raydium） 这四层叙事进行炒作。
长期关键：项目能否真正落地，取决于上市公司是否接受、链下股权/股息权利是否真实对应、资产能否顺畅赎回，以及交易场所是否满足监管的具体条件（TSV）。
风险提示：许多新协议（如 Pare、Gage、Note、https://t.co/tIaRLYPy43）仍处于初创早期，存在未经审计、合规风险高（如对美国用户限制）及市场波动剧烈等不确定性。

原来不仅仅是FomoPeek😨😨是 iOS 历史漏洞正被黑灰产大规模利用

🚨⚠️【紧急预警】慢雾：FomoPeek 类恶意 App 已可读取备忘录，iPhone 用户请立刻更新到 iOS 27

9月19日，慢雾创始人余弦（@evilcos）在首轮 FomoPeek 预警后再次补充：这不只是单个 App 的问题，而是 iOS 历史漏洞正被黑灰产大规模利用，类似案例已不止 FomoPeek，社区还反馈了 https://t.co/tpGe2H1TUV 等同源手法。水坑可能到处都是...

余弦称，安全团队验证发现：FomoPeek 等恶意 App 还能读取已打开的 iPhone 备忘录。

这意味着：只要装过、打开过这类 App，风险可能不只是钥匙串里的账号，还包括之后打开过的钱包私钥，甚至备忘录里记下的助记词、密码和聊天摘录。

另需注意：此前公布的受影响范围为 iOS 12.0–18.7、26.0–26.1，但 26.x 的实际影响范围仍在确认，可能比先前公布的更宽。

请立刻做这几件事🔰🔰

1、能更新就更新到 iOS 27。 这是目前最直接的防护动作。
2、打开钱包 App 前，先关掉其他非主流 App；Safari 若开着不明网页，也先关掉。
3、不要再下载来源不明的 App，不要重新安装 FomoPeek。
4、若曾安装或打开过 FomoPeek 1.1–1.2，或访问过类似页面：立刻检查资产是否异常；
5、在从未装过该 App 的干净设备上生成全新私钥/助记词；
6、尽快把资产转到新地址；
7、默认备忘录、Keychain、本地文件都可能已泄露，不要在旧设备上继续导入旧密钥。

余弦提醒‼️：这不是“某个钱包 App 不安全”，而是系统级历史漏洞被拿来规模化偷币。慢雾团队（@SlowMist_Team）将另发详细披露。在此之前，先更新系统、隔离旧设备、转移资产。
